name: sepia-crt-moodboard
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a warm-toned photo collage — several clipped studio portraits layered and overlapping, some of them nested inside the screens of stacked vintage CRT televisions.
· GROUND: a flat pale grey-to-cream studio seamless behind the whole stack.
· PALETTE: heavily sepia — tan, warm brown, amber and cream — with cool olive / metallic-green sheen on the skin highlights and muted desaturation overall.
· LIGHT: soft directional studio light with glossy green-gold rim highlights along cheekbones and lips.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: faces embedded in chunky old CRT TV frames stacked like a totem, cut-out figures overlapping each other, tiny geometric accent marks scattered in the margins.
· MOOD: nostalgic, grungy, early-2000s moodboard, faded and dreamy.
· GRAIN: heavy visible film grain and analogue haze, slightly soft and washed, degraded-photocopy feel.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
